================================================================
CALIBRATION DEFECT - READ BEFORE WIRING THIS GATE INTO CI
================================================================

The sdk-js-ratchet thresholds above were derived from sdk-js-740, which
is a NARROW scan: 46 files, 6,340 ncloc, 0 vulnerabilities.

The full sdk-js codebase is sdk-js-740-full: 123 files, 16,587 ncloc,
and 36 vulnerabilities. That is 2.7x the files and 2.6x the code, and
the vulnerability count goes from 0 to 36.

So the gate as it stands is calibrated against roughly a third of the
repository. Wired to a full-repo scan it would trip "vulnerabilities
GT 0" on day one and stay red - and a permanently red gate is a gate
somebody switches off, which is worse than no gate.

This is the same failure the narrow scan already produced once as a
REPORT: "all clean" was stated on the strength of 46 files and 0 vulns,
and the full-codebase numbers contradicted it. The instrument measured
a third of the subject and the result was read as covering all of it.

Two things must be settled before this gate goes live, and neither is
mine to settle alone:

  1. SCOPE. What should the gate scan? Candidates:
       - what SHIPS (src/ plus the six plugins), or
       - the whole repository including samples/ and quickstart/.
     The 36 vulnerabilities are concentrated in the half that does not
     ship, which is exactly why the narrow scan looked clean. But the
     samples are the surface the XSS and missing-SRI findings came from
     (fixed in #62), so "does not ship" is not "does not matter".

  2. THRESHOLDS. Whichever scope is chosen, re-derive the numbers
     against THAT scope. Do not carry the sdk-js-ratchet numbers above
     forward - they belong to sdk-js-740 and to nothing else.

sdk-net-740 does not have this problem: 67 files / 33,294 ncloc is the
whole of that repository, and sdk-net-ratchet is calibrated to it.

Recorded on STP-740. The gate was demonstrated to pass AND to fail on
the local container before these objects were deleted; what is
unsettled is the scope it should judge, not whether it functions.
